questions.question: In a class of 60 students, 35 like maths, 30 like physics and 15 like both. How many like neither subject?
questions.solution:
n(M ∪ P) = n(M) + n(P) − n(M ∩ P) = 35 + 30 − 15 = 50.

Number who like neither = 60 − 50 = **10**.

questions.question: Prove that: tan A + tan B = sin(A + B)/(cos A cos B). Hence find the value of tan 75°.
Find the equation of the line passing through (2, −3) and perpendicular to the line 3x − 4y + 5 = 0.
questions.solution:
Given line slope m₁ = −a/b = −3/−4 = 3/4.

Perpendicular slope m₂ = −1/m₁ = −4/3.

y + 3 = (−4/3)(x − 2) ⇒ 3y + 9 = −4x + 8 ⇒ **4x + 3y + 1 = 0**.
